description: This file defines the `CredentialsResult` class, a generic container for representing the result of credentials-related API responses within the Hono project. It provides various static factory methods to create instances with different sets of information, such as status code, payload, cache directives, and application properties.

classes.name: CredentialsResult
classes.description: A final class representing the container for credentials API results, extending RequestResponseResult to include status, payload, cache directives, and application properties.

methods.name: from(int status)
methods.description: Creates a CredentialsResult with only a status code, defaulting cache directive to no-cache and no payload.

methods.name: from(int status, T payload)
methods.description: Creates a CredentialsResult with a status code and payload, cache directive defaulted to no-cache.

methods.name: from(int status, T payload, CacheDirective cacheDirective)
methods.description: Creates a CredentialsResult with status, payload, and specified cache directive.

methods.name: from(int status, T payload, CacheDirective cacheDirective, ApplicationProperties applicationProperties)
methods.description: Creates a CredentialsResult with status, payload, cache directive, and application properties for more detailed response configuration.
